_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

eligibility_engine.notes: FD-backed secured card: the credit limit is 90% of the fixed deposit (KFS). The minimum deposit is not stated in the SBM documents read.

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% processing fee on rental payments (MCC 6513), over and above any merchant convenience fee (MITC Table 07; page FAQ 8)
1% processing fee on education payments (MCCs 8211, 8220, 8241, 8244, 8249, 8299), over and above any merchant convenience fee (MITC Table 07; page FAQ 8)

components: 5% of the outstanding amount or ₹100, whichever is greater (POS/ECOM)
plus overdue minimum payments, any amount over the credit limit and EMI instalments due

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Membership and annual fees are nil (KFS; MITC Table 01). Card replacement ₹249 + GST; card cancellation ₹499 + GST within two years of activation (with effect from 23 Oct 2026, KFS).

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: SBM ZET Credit Card KFS (SBM file dated 12 Oct 2026; late fee and cancellation fee marked with effect from 23 Oct 2026)

SBM Secured Credit Card MITC and Cardholder Member Agreement, 52 pages (SBM file dated 29 Oct 2026): Tables 01-11 give fees, interest, late fee, forex, surcharge, rent and education fees, cash limits and minimum due for every variant
SBM secured credit card page (read 7 Nov 2026): lists the card with its KFS, MITC and reward links; card image https://www.sbm.bank.in/images/cards/sbm-zet-card.webp shows the network

open_questions: HELD, no published reward rate: the SBM page links only a KFS and an MITC for ZET and describes UPI payments plus FD interest; there is no SBM reward document. Partner pages on zetapp.in advertise cashback tied to a paid ZET Plus subscription and gift-voucher discounts; those are partner marketing, not an SBM document, and are not used as facts.
Network: the page text calls it "an FD-backed RuPay credit card" and the card image shows the RuPay logo. The KFS does not name the network.
The minimum deposit is not stated by SBM; MITC Table 06 only shows virtual cards for FDs below ₹5,000 and physical cards at ₹5,000 or more.
Fuel surcharge: the KFS says "Surcharge Fee 1%"; MITC clause 8.7 ties it to fuel. No waiver is stated.
notes: Cash interest 3.5% a month from day one; cash limit 50% of the credit limit; ATM fee 3.5% or ₹300, whichever is higher.
EMI: processing fee ₹99 or 1% (whichever is higher) per conversion, 1.5% a month, foreclosure ₹99 or 3% of the remaining principal (MITC Table, EMI charges).
The 1% rent and education fees took effect on 15 Jul 2026 (MITC note to Table 07).

value.rule: 5% of the total outstanding, minimum ₹50 and maximum ₹1,000, + GST (with effect from 23 Oct 2026)
value.source: ZET KFS (12 Oct 2026) and MITC Table 08
